evidence: Public Lighthouse evidence reports that [role] elements are not contained by their required parent role; accessibility tree is reported not well-formed.
user_impact: Screen-reader and other accessibility-tree consumers may receive incorrect structure or miss relationships needed to operate controls.
recommended_fix: Prefer native HTML; where ARIA is required, place child roles under the required parent role and validate with an accessibility checker.

evidence: Public audit reports missing semantic landmark elements: main, nav.
user_impact: Users navigating by landmarks may have difficulty jumping directly to primary content or navigation.
recommended_fix: Add one semantic main region and a nav region with an accessible label where needed.

evidence: Public audit reports only 1 of 34 images with explicit width and height.
user_impact: Late image sizing can shift layout and make controls harder to track, especially for magnification or assistive-technology users.
recommended_fix: Require intrinsic image dimensions or equivalent reserved layout space in the image component.

evidence: GIGW requires manual keyboard testing; a live interactive keyboard pass could not be executed in this environment, so result is explicitly pending.
user_impact: Keyboard-only users may encounter inaccessible controls, poor focus order, or invisible focus if manual verification is skipped.
recommended_fix: Run the provided keyboard checklist locally and attach screenshots for every failure; fix focus order, traps, and focus visibility.

evidence: GIGW explicitly calls for descriptive headings/labels, labelled inputs, and programmatically determinable roles/states.
user_impact: Inconsistent semantics become regressions as the application grows and can disproportionately affect screen-reader and keyboard users.
recommended_fix: Make landmarks, labels, focus styles, accessible names, and live-region behavior part of component/test acceptance criteria.
